card.name: Pieces inside URLs, code and escapes
card.fires_on: Short fragments partway through URL strings, HTML entity text like &ndash, format strings and file paths. It is mostly web or code text, not medical prose.

modes.label: Broken entity or URL piece
modes.description: A fragment inside an encoded URL or an HTML dash entity between dates.

modes.label: Code and format strings
modes.description: A letter or escape inside a date or print format string or a file path.

card.plain: It fires on odd little pieces of web addresses, code and symbols, not on ordinary medical wording.
